fact: The finance ministry's report on the second and third quarters of 2025 says Janjanbureh Area Council has operational internet and IFMIS access for key staff, with plans to increase bandwidth, that Kuntaur Area Council posts live in IFMIS with internet expansion ongoing across all its offices, and that at Brikama Area Council, where IFMIS is being installed for all users, internet speed and connectivity remain challenges.
title: 2nd & 3rd Quarter PFM Performance Report
publisher: Ministry of Finance and Economic Affairs
